showSeconds.name: show seconds
showSeconds.description: Whether to show seconds in the datetime plugin on the dock
showSeconds.description[zh_CN]: 任务栏时间插件是否显示秒，关闭时按短时间格式显示，打开时在短时间格式基础上补充显示秒

showSecondsMode.name: show seconds mode
showSecondsMode.description: Whether to show the show-seconds toggle in control center: true=Enabled, false=Hidden. The toggle is shown disabled when showSeconds is read-only. Only effective when the dock datetime plugin provides a showSeconds config.
showSecondsMode.description[zh_CN]: 控制中心中是否显示秒数开关：true=显示，false=隐藏。当 showSeconds 为只读时，开关显示为禁用。仅在任务栏时间插件提供 showSeconds 配置时生效。
